response.heading_en: THIRD CATEGORY WARNING ON STRONG WINDS AND ROUGH SEAS
response.text_en: SECTION A: FOR MALAYSIAN WATERS [WITHIN 24 NAUTICAL MILES] 1) WARNING ON SEA LEVEL RISE Sea level rise is expected over the waters of East Johor • Pahang • Terengganu • Kelantan until Sunday, 22 November 2026. At risk of inundation of seawater over the coast. 2) THUNDERSTORMS WARNING Thunderstorms, heavy rain and strong winds are expected over the waters of Perlis & Kedah • Penang • Perak • Selangor • Terengganu • Kelantan • Western Sarawak until 9:00 PM; Sunday, 22 November 2026. This condition may cause strong winds up to 50 kmph and rough seas with wave height up to 3.5 metres and is dangerous to small boats. SECTION B: FOR SHIPPING 1) WARNING ON STRONG WINDS AND ROUGH SEAS (THIRD CATEGORY) Strong northeasterly winds over 60 kmph with waves exceeding 4.5 metres are expected over the water of Northeastern Condore until Tuesday, 24 November 2026. This condition of strong winds and rough seas is dangerous to all coastal and shipping activities including workers on oil platforms. 2) WARNING ON STRONG WINDS AND ROUGH SEAS (SECOND CATEGORY) Strong northeasterly winds of 50 - 60 kmph with wave height up to 4.5 metres are expected over the waters of Northwestern Condore • Northwestern Reef North until Tuesday, 24 November 2026. This condition of strong winds and rough seas is dangerous to all shipping and coastal activities including fishing and ferry services. 3) WARNING ON STRONG WINDS AND ROUGH SEAS (FIRST CATEGORY) Strong northeasterly winds of 40 - 50 kmph with wave height up to 3.5 metres are expected over the waters of Southeastern Samui • Northern Tioman • Southern part of Condore • Southwestern and Northeastern parts of Reef North until Tuesday, 24 November 2026. This condition of strong winds and rough seas is dangerous to small crafts, recreational sea activities and water sports. 4) THUNDERSTORMS WARNING Thunderstorms, heavy rain and strong winds are expected over the waters of Southern part of Samui • Northern Tioman • Condore • Northwestern Reef North • Northern Straits Of Melaka • Reef South until 9:00 PM; Sunday, 22 November 2026. This condition may cause strong winds up to 50 kmph and rough seas with wave height up to 3.5 metres and is dangerous to small boats.
response.instruction_en: This condition of strong winds and rough seas is dangerous.
response.heading_bm: AMARAN ANGIN KENCANG DAN LAUT BERGELORA KATEGORI KETIGA
response.text_bm: SEKSYEN A: UNTUK PERAIRAN MALAYSIA [DALAM LINGKUNGAN 24 BATU NAUTIKA] 1) AMARAN KENAIKAN PARAS LAUT Kenaikan paras air laut dijangka di kawasan perairan Johor Timur • Pahang • Terengganu • Kelantan sehingga Ahad, 22 November 2026. Berisiko kepada limpahan air laut di pesisir pantai. 2) AMARAN RIBUT PETIR Ribut petir, hujan lebat dan angin kencang dijangka di kawasan perairan Perlis & Kedah • Pulau Pinang • Perak • Selangor • Terengganu • Kelantan • Sarawak Barat sehingga 9:00 Malam; Ahad, 22 November 2026. Keadaan ini boleh menyebabkan angin kencang sehingga 50 kmsj dan laut bergelora dengan ombak mencapai ketinggian 3.5 meter dan berbahaya kepada bot-bot kecil. SEKSYEN B: UNTUK PERKAPALAN 1) AMARAN ANGIN KENCANG DAN LAUT BERGELORA (KATEGORI KETIGA) Angin kencang timur laut melebihi 60 kmsj dengan ombak setinggi melebihi 4.5 meter dijangka di kawasan perairan Timur Laut Condore sehingga Selasa, 24 November 2026. Keadaan angin kencang dan laut bergelora ini adalah berbahaya kepada semua aktiviti pantai dan perkapalan termasuk pekerja di pelantar minyak. 2) AMARAN ANGIN KENCANG DAN LAUT BERGELORA (KATEGORI KEDUA) Angin kencang timur laut berkelajuan 50 - 60 kmsj dengan ombak mencapai ketinggian sehingga 4.5 meter dijangka di kawasan perairan Barat Laut Condore • Barat Laut Reef North sehingga Selasa, 24 November 2026. Keadaan angin kencang dan laut bergelora ini adalah berbahaya kepada semua aktiviti perkapalan dan pantai termasuk menangkap ikan dan perkhidmatan feri. 3) AMARAN ANGIN KENCANG DAN LAUT BERGELORA (KATEGORI PERTAMA) Angin kencang timur laut berkelajuan 40 - 50 kmsj dengan ombak mencapai ketinggian sehingga 3.5 meter dijangka di kawasan perairan Tenggara Samui • Utara Tioman • Selatan Condore • Barat Daya dan Timur Laut Reef North sehingga Selasa, 24 November 2026. Keadaan angin kencang dan laut bergelora ini adalah berbahaya kepada bot-bot kecil, rekreasi laut dan sukan laut. 4) AMARAN RIBUT PETIR Ribut petir, hujan lebat dan angin kencang dijangka di kawasan perairan Selatan Samui • Utara Tioman • Condore • Barat Laut Reef North • Selat Melaka Utara • Reef South sehingga 9:00 Malam; Ahad, 22 November 2026. Keadaan ini boleh menyebabkan angin kencang sehingga 50 kmsj dan laut bergelora dengan ombak mencapai ketinggian 3.5 meter dan berbahaya kepada bot-bot kecil.
response.instruction_bm: Keadaan angin kencang dan laut bergelora ini adalah berbahaya.
